title: AI Personal Content Engine
tagline: End-to-end content operating system: ideation → creation → distribution → analytics
description: The flagship product - a comprehensive content OS that learns your voice, monitors your niche, generates content calendars, produces multi-format content (articles, threads, videos, carousels), schedules cross-platform distribution, and provides unified analytics with ROI attribution. Currently in private beta with 50 creators.
problem: Creator economy tools are fragmented: ideation (Notion), writing (Claude), design (Canva), scheduling (Buffer), analytics (separate per platform). No unified voice model. No cross-platform ROI. Context switching kills creativity.
solution: Unified platform with 6 pillars: 1) Voice Engine: Fine-tuned LoRA on creator's corpus → consistent voice across formats, 2) Trend Radar: Monitors 500+ sources → opportunity scoring, 3) Content Studio: Multi-format editor with AI co-pilot (outline → draft → polish → format), 4) Distribution Engine: Native API publishing to 8 platforms + webhook fallback, 5) Analytics Hub: Unified metrics + attribution (UTM + first-touch + ML), 6) Monetization: Sponsorship matching + affiliate automation + product recommendations.
architecture: Monorepo (Turborepo): Apps (Next.js web, React Native mobile, Electron desktop) + Packages (voice-engine, trend-radar, content-studio, distribution, analytics, monetization). Backend: Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Realtime + Edge Functions) + Pinecone (voice embeddings) + Redis (queues). AI: GPT-4o + Claude 3.5 + custom LoRA (Modal GPU). CI/CD: Vercel + EAS.
